title: Remaining canvas hint pills adopt the shared .cnv-hint
goal: The small floating hint that names the current gesture on the canvas is redrawn on eight pages, each with its own near-identical copy of the same styling. This points them all at the shared one so the hint stays consistent as it changes.
notes: The 2026-08-23 draw/icon pass promoted .cnv-hint to shared/components/canvas.css (the dark glass pill on the artboard that names the gesture) and adopted it on draw, draw-boolean and vector-wt. Eight pages still hand-roll the same pill under their own name: image, img-bg-remove, img-grade-wt, img-masking (x2), img-retouch-wt, video-audio, video-compositing, video-transitions. Swap each local rule for the shared class, keeping only the page's own top/bottom as a scoped refinement. Verify 200 + audit-sweep.
acceptance: All eight pages use the shared hint styling, keeping only their own placement on the canvas
The hints render the same as before on each page
Every touched page loads without error and passes the automated page sweep
